Lenny (00:00:00): Welcome to the show. Today we talk about activation and onboarding for new users.

Ada Activation (00:00:21): Activation is the moment a new user first experiences real value in your product. We measure activation by the percentage of signups who complete the key action within the first week.

Lenny (00:01:40): How do you find the aha moment for onboarding?

Ada Activation (00:02:05): Look at your retained users and work backwards. Find the action that most separates them from churned users. Then redesign onboarding so every new user reaches that action fast. Improving activation rate is usually the cheapest growth win.
